answer: Live Challenge Bridge. Each identity must answer a fresh, agent-generated task whose correct reply depends on unpredictable state (e.g., the current summit of a changing internal ledger), and the reply is consumed on submission, so it cannot be forwarded or reused. The ivory audit log records every answer hash as spent. An attacker pays one unique computation and one on-chain write per identity, making mass registration cost scale linearly with real work, not capital.
